title: The Ritz Hotel, London

nativeAxes.x: southwest along Piccadilly toward Green Park

identityStatus: Main Ritz footprint matched by long Piccadilly arcade, five-bay Green Park end and longer Arlington wing; William Kent House and 22 Arlington extension remain distinct.
geometryLabel: Mapped historic main hotel footprint; adjacent William Kent House and later 22 Arlington Street extension excluded.

orientationControl.basis: Piccadilly frontage matched to local exterior images, original elevations and floor plans.

terrainContact.basis: Piccadilly sidewalk at the center arcade.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap footprint, inspected local Qualla exterior photographs and floor plans, Historic England listing and Purcell 2021 condition survey.
notes: The map has no measured height. Original elevations and photographed window/storey proportions control approximate heights. The upper main block has a rear courtyard recess above the lower public rooms; the original Arlington entrance wing is lower. Later approved roof/Arlington extension changes are outside this dated model scope.
limitations: Not a survey; heights, courtyard roofs, fine sculpture and service equipment are approximations.
Reference era is principally 2015–2021, excluding subsequent 22 Arlington extension and unverified roof construction changes.
